title: Jeremiyah Love 'disappointed' with fast 40-yard dash: 'Could have run a 4.2'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jeremiyah Love 'disappointed' with fast 40-yard dash: 'Could have run a 4.2'
sources.description: Jeremiyah Love blazed a 4.36-second 40-yard dash that ranked second-best among all RBs at the combine. But the Notre Dame star wasn't satisfied.
